subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should cross-channel acknowledgement text become an extension of the existing `streaming.mode: "progress"` lifecycle, a separate global `messages.ackText` contract, or remain limited to existing reactions, typing, and channel-specific progress drafts?
rationale: Current main has converged on shared progress drafts for some channels, so adding another global configuration surface without choosing the permanent ownership model would duplicate behavior and leave lifecycle semantics inconsistent.

options.title: Extend progress lifecycle
options.body: Add customizable starter text, scope, capability negotiation, and cleanup semantics to the shared progress/presence path, then implement it in additional channel plugins.

options.title: Add global ack text
options.body: Introduce `messages.ackText` and scope fields as a separate pre-dispatch send-and-continue feature across capable channels.

options.title: Keep existing signals
options.body: Treat progress drafts, typing indicators, and acknowledgement reactions as sufficient and decline a new portable text contract.

recommendation.title: Extend progress lifecycle
recommendation.body: Add customizable starter text, scope, capability negotiation, and cleanup semantics to the shared progress/presence path, then implement it in additional channel plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared dispatch and channel acknowledgement history makes this the strongest available owner for choosing the permanent cross-channel lifecycle boundary.
